cand.title: 2027 NextGen Seminar
cand.excerpt: Evidence-backed event and hotel-market fit; accessibility treated conservatively.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Primary organizer contact: Melanie Hofmann, Senior Manager, Events & Professional Development. The official staff page specifically lists Hotel Contracts and Meeting Planning and assigns her responsibility for the NextGen Seminar; the booking PDF copies her on reservation requests. Executive relationship contact: Robert Paterkiewicz, Executive Director & CEO, responsible for association operations, staff, budget and strategic planning. These are relevant organizer-side contacts; sole signing authority is not established. Leidy Jimenez is an incumbent-hotel reservations contact, not the event owner or a demonstrated future-site buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed activity dates: January 24–28, 2027, Dreams Macao Beach, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic; within the requested horizon. The organizer FAQ expressly says the seminar will proceed regardless of the proposed NFDA merger outcome. No verified 2028 seminar dates or venue were found; annual recurrence is not a 2028 commitment.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: a plausible future guestroom-led, family-inclusive resort seminar fit rather than a large convention. The 2027 program combines educational sessions, a welcome reception/dinner, a full free day, guest participation and child accommodation rates at an all-inclusive resort. Wyndham Alltra offers 620 rooms, three meeting spaces totaling 380 m², up to 300 conference/200 banquet guests, outdoor settings and 20 restaurants/bars on Uvero Alto Beach. Those features match the format directionally, but event attendance, actual room demand, breakout layouts and AV requirements are unverified; capacity fit and revenue cannot yet be qualified. There is no sourced evidence that this event requires a city-center hotel.
findings.venueCommitments: Dreams Macao Beach Punta Cana is the announced 2027 host and lodging hotel, supported by event-specific negotiated rates, reservation instructions and deposit/cancellation conditions—not generic resort marketing. Published rates are $239 per person per night for double+ occupancy and $382.40 per night single occupancy in Jr. Suite Pool View rooms. This is incumbent business at another Punta Cana resort, not Wyndham Alltra inventory. The executed contract and contracted room quantity are not public in the reviewed material.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented timeline: 2022 Miami Beach, The Confidante Hotel, January 31–February 3; 2023 Grand Cayman, January 29–February 2; 2024 The Bahamas, January 28–February 1, with an Atlantis Paradise Island dateline; 2025 St. Kitts and Nevis, January 26–30; 2026 San Juan, Puerto Rico, January 25–29; 2027 Punta Cana, January 24–28. This establishes destination variation, not a guaranteed rotation back to Punta Cana. Historical hotel names other than The Confidante are not sufficiently established by the reviewed sources; the 2024 dateline alone is not proof of a hotel contract.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel selection is committed elsewhere; attendee reservations are directed to the incumbent hotel by phone/email, referencing Selected Independent Funeral Homes, not online or through third parties. The official PDF directs email to Leidy Jimenez, copying Kelvin Cordero and Melanie Hofmann; telephone callers should ask the Reservations Department for Leidy. It specifies a two-night initial deposit and final balance due November 22, without restating the year on that line. The block rate lasts until the block fills; additional availability and price are then determined by Dreams. This is not an open hotel RFP. No external PCO/DMC appointment or overflow-hotel arrangement was identified.
findings.organizationStructure: Selected Independent Funeral Homes is the association organizer; its NextGen program serves aspiring and early-career funeral-service leaders, directors and owners. Dreams is the host hotel, not the owner. No agency/PCO/DMC mandate was found. NFDA describes a proposed combination and a 2027 program review that would shape delivery from 2028. Do not record that merger as completed: November 9, 2026 reporting describes continuing litigation over the membership vote. The event FAQ separately protects the announced 2027 seminar regardless of merger outcome.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Dreams holds the announced 2027 seminar and negotiated accommodation block in the core Punta Cana market. Its published block-full provision says Dreams will decide further availability and rate; it does not establish that the block is full, that there is overflow, or that another hotel is being considered. No compression, displacement, sellout, lost-RFP or overflow opportunity was found. Wyndham Alltra should not assume incumbent room nights are accessible.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Melanie Hofmann first with a short future-cycle introduction, explicitly acknowledging the 2027 Dreams commitment; involve Robert Paterkiewicz for continuity and future program ownership. Ask whether a 2028-or-later seminar is approved, whether Punta Cana will be eligible, when destination/hotel review begins, and who will lead sourcing under any organizational transition. Request prior actualized room pickup, peak rooms, guest/child mix, meeting agenda and setup requirements before proposing the Wyndham all-inclusive product. Offer a future site inspection only if invited. Do not send a replacement 2027 block proposal or pursue overflow without an express need.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Not an open 2027 accommodation or meeting-sourcing opportunity for Wyndham Alltra. The verified upcoming edition is committed to Dreams Macao Beach. Participant registration or an available incumbent block does not mean venue sourcing is open. No supported 2027 overflow path exists in the reviewed evidence; relationship outreach remains possible without implying a purchasable room block.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: destination variation and the established annual resort-learning format justify asking to enter a future competitive venue review. They do not establish a 2028 edition, return to the Dominican Republic, an RFP, or an open sourcing window. The proposed NFDA integration and program-review process add uncertainty about future ownership, calendar and procurement. Treat this as nurture for a later uncommitted cycle, not forecastable Wyndham demand.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Ask Melanie for the next approved, uncommitted cycle and whether Punta Cana is under consideration; confirm decision makers and site-review deadlines.
Request historical pickup/peak rooms, guest mix and meeting setup specifications to qualify Wyndham capacity and commercial value.
Confirm post-litigation organizational/procurement ownership directly before routing future-cycle outreach to NFDA; retain Selected as the verified 2027 organizer.
Only investigate 2027 overflow further if the organizer identifies an actual unmet requirement.
remainingUncertainties: No published contracted room-block size, total room nights, peak rooms, actualized pickup or expected total attendance was located. The public participant list is not a published final attendance forecast.
2027 incumbent block pickup, remaining availability and any genuine overflow requirement are unknown; the generic block-full clause does not settle them.
2028 seminar approval, dates, destination, venue, sourcing timetable and procurement owner are unverified.

Latest legal completion and organizational consequences of the proposed NFDA combination remain unresolved; official future-program language is conditional, and November reporting describes litigation.

Historical hotel commitments for 2023, 2025 and 2026 remain unverified; the member archive requires login. Atlantis appears in the 2024 release dateline but is not treated as a proven contracted hotel.
